title: Robust Legs
description: Robust legs session with hip thrusts, curtsy lunges and floor core work

exercises.name: Joint rotations
exercises.instructions: Neck, shoulders, wrists, hips, ankles - slow and controlled

exercises.name: Jumping jacks
exercises.instructions: Jump spreading arms and legs, return feet together

exercises.name: Hip 90/90
exercises.instructions: Seated, legs at 90 degrees, pivot side to side

exercises.name: World's greatest stretch
exercises.instructions: Lunge + thoracic rotation + arm reaching to the sky

exercises.name: Floor hip thrust
exercises.instructions: Back on the floor, feet flat, drive hips up, squeeze glutes

exercises.name: Curtsy lunges
exercises.instructions: Cross leg behind at a diagonal

exercises.name: Bodyweight goblet squat
exercises.instructions: Hands in front of chest, squat deep

exercises.name: Forearm plank
exercises.instructions: On forearms, body perfectly aligned, brace the abs

exercises.name: Scissors
exercises.instructions: Back on the floor, legs extended, cross alternating over/under

exercises.name: Toe touches
exercises.instructions: Back on the floor, legs vertical, reach hands to feet

exercises.name: Pigeon stretch
exercises.instructions: Front leg bent in front, back leg extended, lean forward

exercises.name: Psoas stretch
exercises.instructions: Low lunge, drive the hip forward

exercises.name: Child's pose
exercises.instructions: Kneeling, arms extended forward, forehead on the floor, breathe deeply

exercises.name: Deep breathing
exercises.instructions: Inhale 4s through the nose, hold 4s, exhale 6s through the mouth
